event_summary: An inflated orange balloon-like object attached to a black tube visibly opens near its neck and spreads into a large translucent orange sheet with many small orange specks around its edge.
raw_event_description: At the start, a glossy orange inflated balloon-like object is fixed at its narrow end to a black angled tube on an outdoor patio. For several frames it remains mostly unchanged. The narrow end then visibly changes shape and an orange rim appears around the tube connection. The orange material opens outward from the tube side, forming a widening translucent sheet while the rounded orange body remains visible to the right. The sheet expands across much of the frame, with many small orange specks and fragments appearing along and around its outer edge. A pale whitish streak or plume is visible extending from the tube area through the central part of the opening during the expansion. The background and camera framing remain essentially unchanged.

reasons: The inflated orange object is fully visible before its visible shape change begins.
The black tube and nearby support device are visible at the narrow end.
The outdoor background is visible and stable.

evidence_bank.observation: A large glossy orange inflated object has a narrow end at the left connected to the black tube.
The black tube is angled upward from a small base device at the lower left.
The outdoor background elements remain in the same positions in the frame.
Before the main change, the orange inflated object keeps a smooth rounded teardrop shape.
The orange object's narrow end visibly changes from a tapered shape into a wider orange rim.
A thin orange membrane-like area opens outward from the tube-side end of the orange object.
The opened orange area forms a broad translucent sheet extending upward, downward, and rightward.
The rounded orange portion remains visible to the right of the expanding translucent sheet.
Many small orange specks appear along the outer edge of the translucent orange sheet.
The orange sheet grows to occupy most of the right side and center of the frame.
A pale whitish streak extends from the black tube area into the central region of the orange sheet.
Small orange specks are visible outside the sheet boundary, especially along the right and lower edges.
The black tube and base device remain in nearly the same visible position while the orange object changes.
No scene cut is visible during the sequence.
